items.title: Watford appoint ‘most Watford manager ever’ as 26th boss in 15 years under trigger-happy owner Gino Pozzo
items.summary: WATFORD have appointed Edward Iordanescu as their new manager. The former boss of the Romanian national team becomes the 26th head coach in 15 years under controversial Hornets owner Gino Pozzo. Alessio Dionisi became the latest Vicarage Road casualty on Sunday when he was axed after just 18 games.
